_about: Every string a player reads (PLANNING-BRIEF 0.9). Written from 'Game text' against TONE.md; the build implements each exactly. Keys starting with _ are instructions and are never shown. A string the build needed and this file lacked carries "review": "new" beside it.

game.name: Slushline
game.loading_error: The game could not load. Reload the page and try again.
game.fallback: This game requires JavaScript and WebAssembly.

missions.label: Story mode
missions.desc: Pour slush at corner stores around the world, a new store for each mission.
missions.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-07: story mode, a world tour of stores). Was "Play the missions" and "Fill each mission's orders to open the next one."

local.label: Play at one keyboard
local.desc: Two players share this keyboard, and each one runs a line.

online.label: Play a friend online
online.desc: One of you hosts a match and the other joins it.

replay.label: Load a replay
replay.desc: Open a replay file and watch that run again.

spout.title: Spouts and handles
spout.body: Hold {key.spout_1} to pull the handle on the first spout. The spout opens further the longer you hold the key, until it is fully open. Let go and a spring swings the handle shut.

lead.title: The belt keeps moving
lead.body: Start pouring before the cup is under the spout, because the slush takes a moment to fall and the belt carries the cup along while it does.

tail.title: The tail
tail.body: Let go before the cup looks full. The handle takes a moment to swing shut, and the slush already in the air still has to land.

swell.title: Slush swells
swell.body: Slush grows for about {swell_s} seconds after it leaves the spout, so a cup keeps rising after you let go. Stop short of the rim and let the slush fill the rest.

order.title: Orders
order.body: Each cup carries its order as a bar above it. The bar shows which flavors the cup should hold and how much of the cup each one gets, which is that flavor's share. Each flavor has its own pattern and short name, so the bar can be read without color.

score.title: How a cup is scored
score.body: A cup is scored out of {max_score} when it reaches the lid. Slush counts toward the score while its flavor is still under its share. Slush past that share, and slush of a flavor the order did not ask for, takes up room and adds nothing.

pass.title: Passing a mission
pass.body: A mission's score is the average of its cups. To pass, reach the mission's mark and keep your waste under its limit. Waste is slush that lands outside a cup.

blend.title: Blends
blend.body: A blend spout pours more than one flavor, in shares that do not change. The label on the spout lists them. When an order's shares differ from the blend's, pour part of the cup from the blend and the rest from a single-flavor spout.

files.title: Replays and save files
files.body: Download a run as a replay from its result screen. Loading that file plays the same run again, input for input. Settings has the save file, which holds your progress through the missions.

belt.title: Belt speed
belt.body: Hold {key.belt_faster} to speed the belt up and {key.belt_slower} to slow it down. The belt keeps the speed you leave it at, so slow it while a cup fills and speed it up between cups.

hud.belt_keys: Hold {key.belt_slower} to slow the belt and {key.belt_faster} to speed it up.
hud.keys_lower: Your keys for the lower line, in spout order: {keys_lower}.

order.mixed: Fill {count} cups. Each cup carries its own order.
order.layered: Fill {count} cups with {recipe}, in layers from the bottom up.

missions.pass: To pass, average {pass} of {max_score} and keep waste under {waste_limit_pct} percent.

heavy.name: Heavy slush
heavy.desc: Raspberry slush is heavy: it falls faster and sinks through lighter slush.

jet_second.name: A rocket nozzle

turning_slow_against.name: Plates that turn the other way

heat.name: Heat
heat.desc: Slush melts away a few seconds after it pours, so slush poured early may be gone before its cup reaches the lid.

heat_fast.name: Fierce heat
heat_fast.desc: Slush melts away even sooner after it pours.

speed_run.name: Rush
speed_run.desc: The belt speeds up on its own as the mission goes on.
speed_run.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

speed_run_hard.name: A harder rush

speed_run_hard.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

open.name: An open belt

mirror.name: A belt running back
mirror.desc: The lower belt runs the other way, so its cups come back under the spouts.
mirror.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

long_line.name: The long line
long_line.desc: The line is longer than any before, with its spouts spread along it.
long_line.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

gauntlet_charge.name: A charge at the first spout
gauntlet_charge.desc: A charge beside the first spout pushes its slush away as it falls.
gauntlet_charge.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

gauntlet_plates.name: Turning plates at the second spout
gauntlet_plates.desc: Plates under the second spout push one way, then the other.
gauntlet_plates.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

jet_gauntlet.name: A jet at the third spout
jet_gauntlet.desc: The third spout fires its slush straight down.
jet_gauntlet.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

heat_long.name: Long heat
heat_long.desc: Slush melts away after a while, so slush from the first spout may be gone before the long line ends.
heat_long.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K01.name: Holding a handle open
K01.when: A cup is under a spout.
K01.then: Hold the spout's key to pull its handle, and the valve opens as the handle swings.

K02.name: The tail
K02.then: Let go early, because the handle takes a moment to shut and the slush in the air still lands.

K03.name: Reading an order
K03.when: A cup comes toward the first spout.
K03.then: Read its order bar, so you know which handles that cup needs.

K04.name: Two flavors in one cup
K04.then: Fill part of the cup at one spout and the rest at the next, because each spout gets one pass at it.

K05.name: Unequal shares
K05.when: An order gives one flavor more of the cup.
K05.then: Pour longer at that flavor's spout, and stop where its share ends on the bar.

K06.name: Letting a cup pass
K06.when: A cup reaches a spout its order does not name.
K06.then: Keep that handle shut, because a flavor the order did not ask for takes up room.

K07.name: A third share in one pass
K07.when: An order names a third flavor.
K07.then: Stop each pour where its share ends, because the belt does not go back.

K08.name: A blend pours its parts
K08.when: A spout's label lists two flavors.
K08.then: Expect both in the cup, in the shares the label lists.

K09.name: Topping up a blend
K09.when: An order's shares differ from a blend's.
K09.then: Pour part of the cup from the blend and the rest from a single-flavor spout.

K10.name: Pouring from a moving spout
K10.when: A spout slides back and forth on a rail.
K10.then: Pull its handle as it comes over the cup, because slush falls straight down from where the spout is.

K11.name: A blend and a rail together
K11.when: A line has a blend and a sliding spout.
K11.then: Pour the blend's part of the cup first, then time the sliding spout to the cup.

K12.name: Two lines at once
K12.then: Watch whichever cup is closest to a spout, since that one needs you next.

K13.name: Aiming through a field
K13.when: A field pushes the slush along the belt as it falls.
K13.then: Pour later than usual, because the slush lands past its spout.

K14.name: A field against the belt
K14.when: A field pushes the slush back against the belt.
K14.then: Pour earlier, because the slush lands before its spout.

K15.name: A charge that pushes
K15.when: A charge sits beside a spout.
K15.then: Expect the stream to bend away from the charge, and aim where it bends to.

K16.name: A charge that pulls
K16.when: A charge pulls a stream toward it.
K16.then: Expect the stream to bend toward the charge, and pour so it bends into the cup.

K17.name: A field that turns
K17.when: A field's push changes direction while you wait.
K17.then: Pour when the push points toward the cup, and hold off when it points away.

K18.name: A blend through the fields
K18.when: A blend and a field are on one line.
K18.then: Aim the blend's part of the cup and the single flavor's part through their own fields.

K19.name: Two belts at two speeds
K19.when: The lower belt runs faster than the upper one.
K19.then: Serve the line whose next cup reaches its spout first.

K20.name: A blend above, a rail below
K20.when: Each line has its own complication.
K20.then: Treat each line as the mission you learned it in, and switch between them cup by cup.

K21.name: Everything at once
K21.when: Two lines carry fields, blends and a rail.
K21.then: Slow the belts when a pour is hard to aim, and speed them up between cups.

K22.name: Two fields under one spout
K22.when: Two fields push one stream in turn.
K22.then: Expect the stream to bend one way and then the other, and aim for where it ends.

K23.name: A field for each spout
K23.when: Each spout has its own field.
K23.then: Aim each pour through its own field.

K24.name: Two turning fields
K24.when: Two fields turn together, pushing opposite ways.
K24.then: Pour each spout when its own field points toward the cup.

K25.name: High cups and low cups
K25.then: Lead the low cups more than the high ones.

K26.name: A cup on a lift
K26.when: A cup rises and falls under the spout.
K26.then: Pour so the slush lands while the cup is under the spout.

K27.name: Rows on lifts
K27.when: Cups ride at two heights and bob.
K27.then: Read each cup's height as it comes, and lead it to match.

K28.name: Heavy slush
K28.when: A slush falls faster than the others.

K29.name: Layers
K29.when: An order's flavors are layers, and none of them sinks.

K30.name: Slush that sinks
K30.when: A heavy slush sinks through a lighter one.
K30.then: Pour the other layer first and let the heavy one sink through it.

K31.name: The jet
K31.when: A spout fires straight down with no fall time.
K31.then: Pour while the cup is under it, with no lead.

K32.name: A jet beside a stream
K32.when: One spout falls and one fires.
K32.then: Lead the falling one and not the jet.

K33.name: A jet over two rows
K33.when: A jet pours on cups at two heights.
K33.then: Use the jet on any cup; lead the falling spout by each cup's height.

K34.name: A tall cup
K34.when: The cup is tall and narrow.
K34.then: Pour longer, because the slush stacks up in a narrow column.
K34.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K35.name: A wide bowl
K35.when: The cup is wide and shallow.
K35.then: Pour into the middle, because the walls lean far out.
K35.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K36.name: A cone
K36.when: The cup narrows to a point at its floor.
K36.then: Let go a little early, because the bottom fills fast.
K36.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K37.name: A narrow neck
K37.when: The cup narrows at the top.
K37.then: Aim at the neck, because slush on the shoulders slides off.
K37.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K38.name: A waist
K38.when: The cup pinches in the middle.
K38.then: Aim at the middle, because the slush has to pass the waist.
K38.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K39.name: A small mouth on a big cup
K39.when: The cup is round, with a small mouth.
K39.then: Aim at the mouth and keep pouring, because the cup holds more than it looks.
K39.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K40.name: Two shapes at once
K40.when: Each line carries a different cup.
K40.then: Lead each line for its own cup.
K40.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K41.name: Two narrow openings at once
K41.when: Both lines carry cups with narrow openings.
K41.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: cups with fun shapes, a mission on each row of the tour)

K42.name: Melting slush
K42.when: Slush melts away a few seconds after it pours.
K42.then: Get it to the lid sooner, by pouring late or speeding the belt up.
K42.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K43.name: A belt that speeds up
K43.when: The belt speeds up on its own.
K43.then: Lead the cups more as it goes faster.
K43.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K44.name: Pouring through a belt
K44.when: Slush that misses the upper cups falls to a belt below that runs the other way.
K44.then: Aim between the upper cups for the lower ones.
K44.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K45.name: Heat and speed
K45.when: Slush melts fast while the belt speeds up.
K45.then: Let the faster belt carry the slush to the lid before it melts.
K45.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K46.name: A gauntlet
K46.when: Each spout along a long line has its own push or beam.
K46.then: Solve each spout on its own.
K46.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K47.name: Two belts speeding up
K47.when: Both belts of a mirror line speed up.
K47.then: Watch where each belt's cups will be.
K47.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

K48.name: Everything at once
K48.when: A long line, melting slush and a belt that speeds up.
K48.then: Speed the belt up early, and solve each spout as it comes.
K48.review: new (Sam, 2026-10-08: wild shifts, a mission on each row from the desert to the lighthouse)

kc_edge.K01_K02: The tail is the same handle, let go before the cup looks full.
kc_edge.K03_K04: An order with two flavors is read the same way, and asks for two pours.
kc_edge.K04_K05: Unequal shares are two pours of different lengths.
kc_edge.K03_K06: Reading the order tells you which spouts to let a cup pass.
kc_edge.K05_K07: A third share is one more unequal pour.
kc_edge.K06_K07: With a third spout, each pour stops where its share ends.
kc_edge.K04_K08: A blend fills two flavors of an order in one pour.
kc_edge.K06_K08: The blend takes the place of the cherry spout, so cherry comes with cola.
kc_edge.K08_K09: When the order's shares differ from the blend's, the blend fills part of the cup.
kc_edge.K05_K09: The rest of the cup is an unequal share from a single-flavor spout.
kc_edge.K04_K10: The two pours are the same, and one of them moves.
kc_edge.K02_K10: The tail now has to land while the spout is still over the cup.
kc_edge.K09_K11: The blend fills its part of the cup as before.
kc_edge.K10_K11: The sliding spout pours the rest.
kc_edge.K03_K12: Each line's orders are read the same way.
kc_edge.K04_K12: Each line asks for the same pours as one line did.
kc_edge.K01_K03: Reading the order decides which handle to hold.
kc_edge.K01_K13: A pour through a field is the same handle, timed to where the slush lands.
kc_edge.K05_K16: The order's shares are unequal, so one pour is longer.
kc_edge.K16_K17: A field that turns is a push whose side changes.
kc_edge.K10_K17: A field that turns is timed as a moving spout is.
kc_edge.K17_K18: The fields are the same, with a blend poured through one.
kc_edge.K11_K18: The blend fills its part of the cup as before.
kc_edge.K10_K19: Timing a cup that moves is what a faster belt asks for.
kc_edge.K11_K20: The blend and the rail are the ones met before.
kc_edge.K18_K21: The fields return on two lines.
kc_edge.K13_K15: A charge bends a stream from one side, as the plates did from below.
kc_edge.K03_K15: Each cup's order says which spout's charge matters.
kc_edge.K15_K14: Plates that push against the belt bend the stream the other way, all the way down.
kc_edge.K06_K14: A cup can still pass a spout its order does not name.
kc_edge.K14_K16: A charge that pulls bends the stream back, as the plates against the belt did.
kc_edge.K12_K20: Two lines again, each with something met before.
kc_edge.K20_K19: Two lines again, now with belts at different speeds.
kc_edge.K19_K21: The two belts return, with fields on them.
kc_edge.K13_K22: One field becomes two, pushing opposite ways.
kc_edge.K22_K23: The fields spread to each spout.
kc_edge.K04_K25: Two flavors in each cup, at two heights.
kc_edge.K25_K26: The cups now move up and down.
kc_edge.K03_K28: An order of one heavy flavor.
kc_edge.K02_K31: The tail of a jet is short, because it has no fall.
kc_edge.K31_K32: A jet and a falling spout on one line.
kc_edge.K32_K33: The jet over cups at two heights.
kc_edge.K28_K30: The heavy flavor goes underneath by itself.
kc_edge.K30_K29: Now the layers are yours to pour in order.
kc_edge.K36_K37: From a wide mouth to a narrow one.
kc_edge.K37_K38: From a narrow neck to a narrow waist.
kc_edge.K40_K41: Two narrow openings, on two lines.
kc_edge.K34_K36: From a tall cup to one with almost no floor.
kc_edge.K38_K35: From a narrow waist to a wide, shallow bowl.
kc_edge.K35_K39: From a wide mouth to a small one on a round body.
kc_edge.K03_K42: From two spouts to slush that melts.
kc_edge.K42_K43: From melting slush to a belt that speeds up.
kc_edge.K43_K44: From one belt to two that run opposite ways.
kc_edge.K44_K45: Melting and a faster belt, together.
kc_edge.K45_K46: From one push to a line of them.

kc_edge.K47_K48: The whole gauntlet, melting and speeding up.
